review: The quoted-fiction model changes source quotation marks, so the unchanged provenance validator rejects it and task remains retry_wait. The auxiliary driver correctly stops an unfinished task instead of continuing/retrying it under another case. Later metadata and importance controls are not executed.
implementation_issue: Prefix-only input cleanup unnecessarily also applied NFKC to every non-command source. Narrow it to only removing the existing command prefix, preserve ordinary punctuation, and recognize explicit do-not-save directives as ineligible source clauses. No model-output repair or provenance relaxation.
